name: community.general.uptimerobot
examples:
- name: Pause the monitor with an ID of 12345
  community.general.uptimerobot:
    monitorid: 12345
    apikey: 12345-1234512345
    state: paused

- name: Start the monitor with an ID of 12345
  community.general.uptimerobot:
    monitorid: 12345
    apikey: 12345-1234512345
    state: started

check_mode.description: Can run in C(check_mode) and return changed status prediction without modifying target.

diff_mode.description: Returns details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in C(check_mode)), when in diff mode.

shortDescription: Pause and start Uptime Robot monitoring
description: This module lets you start and pause Uptime Robot Monitoring.

deprecated.alternative: Use the Uptime Robot API v3 directly with the 'ansible.builtin.uri' module.
deprecated.why: The module uses the Uptime Robot API v1, which was retired and is no longer available.

notes: Support for adding and removing monitors and alert contacts has not yet been implemented.

monitorid.description: ID of the monitor to check.

state.description: Define whether or not the monitor should be running or paused.
